content: {"decision":"CREATE","type":"exploratory","scope":"ALFWorld pick-cool-then-place tasks where the target cooking vessel is not immediately visible and must be located by searching receptacles in the order listed in the initial room observation.","hypothesis":"Prioritizing open cooking surfaces (e.g., stove burners) early in the sequential search, rather than strictly following the full listed order starting with closed storage receptacles, will locate the target cooking vessel faster while still satisfying the ordered-search contract when applied to the relevant subset of receptacles.","guidance":"Navigate to the first available open cooking surface from the entry observation. If not found or if no such surface is reachable, fall back to visiting the next closed storage receptacle in the listed order, opening it if necessary, and inspecting its contents.","probe_spec":{"local_function":"Locate and acquire the target cooking vessel from a candidate receptacle.","realization_pattern":"Navigate to an open cooking surface first; if unsuccessful, iterate through closed storage receptacles in listed order, opening each before inspection, until the target is found and taken.","capability_requirements":["go to","open","take","look"],"adaptive_policy":"Select the first open cooking surface visible in the current observation. Do not interact with non-target objects.","evidence_goal":"Observation confirming the target cooking vessel is now in inventory, along with the number of receptacles visited compared to a strict full-list traversal.","stop_conditions":["Target object successfully taken into inventory","All plausible cooking-related receptacles exhausted without finding the target","An action fails due to invalid state or missing capability","Inventory contains a non-target object (abort)"],"required_downstream_state":"Target cooking vessel held in agent inventory; agent positioned at the receptacle where the target was found, ready for the cooling phase."},"source_grounding":{"entry_action":"go to stoveburner_1","why_grounded":"stoveburner_1 is explicitly listed in the entry observation and its corresponding go-to action is present in the currently admissible actions list.","public_capability_evidence":["Entry observation lists stoveburner_1 among visible entities","Admissible actions include 'go to stoveburner_1'","Historical capability vocabulary includes 'go to' action schema"]},"provenance":["entry_state.admissible_actions","entry_state.observation","historical_capability_vocabulary.action_names","pre_update_established_memories.established-search-listed-order-general","pre_update_established_memories.established-cool-then-place-routine"],"reason":"The established memory prescribes searching all receptacles in listed order, but for a cooking vessel target, testing whether prioritizing open cooking surfaces first yields faster acquisition provides a discriminative local comparison without violating the downstream cooling requirement."}
